title: Flame-Retardant GF-PSB/DOPO-POSS Composite with Low Dk/Df and High Thermal Stability for High-Frequency Copper Clad Applications
authors: Ke Zheng; Yizhi Zhang; Jiaxiang Qiu; Guanqun Xie; Zengbiao Huang; Wei Lin; Zhimeng Liu; Qianfa Liu; Xiaoxia Wang

material_form: glass fabric reinforced styrene-butadiene composite laminate
material_form_TGA: glass fabric reinforced styrene-butadiene composite laminate
material_form_LOI: glass fabric reinforced styrene-butadiene composite laminate
source_material_form_TGA_raw: GF-PSB laminate with 10 wt% flame retardant; glass fiber cloth prepregs stacked and hot-pressed. TG aliquot handling is unreported.
TGA_specimen_preparation: Samples of the corresponding GF-PSB laminate were heated from 50 to 800 °C at 10 °C/min under nitrogen flowing at 60 mL/min. Aliquot mass, size, cutting or grinding, pan and replication are unreported.
LOI_method: ASTM D2863-2008; FTT0077 oxygen index meter, Fire Testing Technology
LOI_statistic: Table 2 reports a value with ± uncertainty; uncertainty type and LOI replicate count are unreported
source_LOI_dimensions_raw: Method section 2.4.4: 130 × 6.5 × 3.2 mm³; Table 2 footnote: laminate thickness 0.25 mm
source_LOI_uncertainty_type: Reported ±; SD or another uncertainty type not defined
LOI_specimen_preparation: The same named 10 wt% flame-retardant GF-PSB laminate was measured. Preparation and Table 2 report a laminate thickness of 0.25 mm, whereas the general LOI method gives 130 × 6.5 × 3.2 mm³ bars. The source does not resolve this discrepancy or describe stacking for LOI.
source_numeric_evidence_description: Supplementary Table S1 supplies exact T5, maximum-rate temperature and residue at 555 °C; main Table 2 supplies measured LOI with source-reported ± uncertainty. Main section 3.3 repeats the T5 and residue values.
conditions_locator: Main sections 2.1–2.4.5, pages 3–5; section 3.2 and Figure 5 caption, pages 6–7; Table 2 footnotes, page 8
TG_locator: Official supplementary Table S1, page 1; main section 3.3, page 6, and Figure 5b, page 7
LOI_locator: Main Table 2 and footnotes, page 8; measured LOI method section 2.4.4, page 4
source_location: Main PDF pages 3–8: preparation, methods, Tables 1–2, sections 3.2–3.4 and Figure 5b; supplementary PDF page 1, Table S1 with definitions
source_T5_definition: Table S1 footnote a: temperature with 5% weight loss
source_Tmax_definition: Table S1 footnote b: temperature with maximum decomposition rate
washing_state: Initial hot-pressed laminate; no durability wash assigned
treatment_method: A varnish was prepared from PSB resin, flame retardant, SiO2 filler and curing agent in toluene at approximately 65 wt% solid content and stirred for 4 h. Glass fiber cloth was immersed for 5 min, passed through a roller, cut to size and dried at 120 °C for 12 h. Several prepreg layers were stacked and hot-pressed at 200 °C for 150 min. The source reports a resulting thickness of 0.25 mm; ply count, pressing pressure, glass weave, curing-agent identity and separate additive fractions are unreported.
limitations: The source consistently assigns TG and measured LOI to the same named 10 wt% flame-retardant GF-PSB laminates, but their thickness is unresolved: preparation, Table 2 and figures state 0.25 mm, while the general LOI method states 3.2 mm. No stacking procedure or correction is inferred. The number of glass-cloth plies, weave, TG aliquot handling and mass, pan, LOI conditioning and replicate count are unreported. The three parallel tests are stated under vertical burning and are not assigned to LOI or TG. Table 2 ± values have no defined uncertainty type and are not relabeled as SD. The 555 °C residue temperature comes directly from supplementary Table S1; the 800 °C method endpoint is not substituted. Figure 5b displays the laminate TG curves only to approximately 555 °C. The GF-PSB control LOI does not inherit the separate PSB resin TG. Unreinforced 20 wt% resin films and the 13/15 wt% DOPO-POSS laminates are separate dielectric specimens and are not assigned these TG/LOI results. The exact curing-agent identity and individual proportions within the other-additives fraction are unreported. The comparator PX-200 content is explicitly 10 wt%, but its other mass fractions are not listed. The DOPO-POSS laminate fractions and the 20 wt% unreinforced PX-200 film recipe are not transferred to it.
sample_state: GF-PSB/PX-200; 10 wt% flame retardant; initial laminate
pairing_evidence: Supplementary Table S1 and main Table 2 use the identical GF-PSB/PX-200 sample name. Figure 5 caption and Table 2 footnotes each specify 10 wt% of the corresponding flame retardant. Section 3.2 states that the 10 wt% DOPO-POSS formulation was selected for the subsequent laminate tests. No precursor or neat-resin TG is substituted.
composition: Glass fabric reinforced PSB laminate containing 10 wt% PX-200. The source does not provide the remaining formulation fractions for this comparator; the GF-free 20 wt% PX-200 row is a different specimen.
treatment_chemistry: PX-200: tetrakis(2,6-dimethylphenyl)-1,3-phenylene bis(phosphate), commercial Daihachi Chemical Industry product; laminate loading 10 wt%
source_formulation_raw: Table 2 footnote 2 and Figure 5 caption: PX-200 content 10 wt%. No GF-PSB/PX-200 formulation row in Table 1.

composition: Table 1 GF-PSB/DOPO-POSS-10: PSB 40 wt%, DOPO-POSS 10 wt%, glass fiber cloth 33 wt%, and curing agent plus SiO2 fillers 17 wt%. PSB is R100 styrene-butadiene block copolymer, source specifications 70 wt% vinyl and 17–27 wt% styrene.
treatment_chemistry: DOPO-functionalized polyhedral oligomeric silsesquioxane, 10 wt% of the laminate. OV-POSS 24.00 g (37.91 mmol), DOPO 73.76 g (341.21 mmol) and AIBN 1.25 g (7.58 mmol) in 110 mL toluene were stirred under N2 at 80 °C for 10 h. After cooling, the upper toluene was decanted, the paste dissolved in 90 mL CH2Cl2, precipitated into 1200 mL ethyl acetate, filtered and vacuum-dried at 100 °C overnight.
source_formulation_raw: GF-PSB/DOPO-POSS-10: PSB/PX-200/DOPO-POSS/GF/other additives = 40/0/10/33/17 wt%; other additives are curing agent and SiO2 fillers.
